  10 func _ready() -> void:
  11 	var content := build_modal("绯月赌城", "VELVET ECLIPSE", true, 940)
  12 	add_label(content, "斩断赌城诅咒，夺回被庄家囚禁的命运。", 24)
  13 	add_button(content, "开始游戏", "new_run", "StartButton")
  14 	continue_button = add_button(content, "继续游戏", "continue_run", "ContinueButton")
  15 	detail = add_label(content, "正在检查存档…", 20)
  16 	add_label(content, CONTROLS, 22)
  17 	add_label(content, "浏览器：先点击游戏画面取得键盘焦点\n↑ / ↓ 选择 · Enter 确认 · 也可直接点击按钮", 20)

  19 func build_modal(heading: String, subtitle: String, opaque: bool = false, width: float = 860.0) -> VBoxContainer:
  20 	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
  21 	var veil := ColorRect.new()
  22 	veil.name = "Veil"
  23 	veil.color = Color(0.028, 0.018, 0.057, 1.0 if opaque else 0.78)
  24 	add_child(veil)
  25 	veil.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
  26 	veil.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
  27 	var center := CenterContainer.new()
  28 	center.name = "Center"
  29 	add_child(center)
  30 	center.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
  31 	center.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
  32 	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
  33 	panel.name = "Panel"
  34 	panel.custom_minimum_size.x = width
  35 	center.add_child(panel)
  36 	var content := VBoxContainer.new()
  37 	content.name = "Content"
  38 	panel.add_child(content)
  39 	add_label(content, heading, 48, Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.49))
  40 	if not subtitle.is_empty():
  41 		add_label(content, subtitle, 23, Color(0.79, 0.67, 0.95))
  42 	return content

  44 func add_label(parent: Node, text_value: String, font_size: int = 22, color: Color = Color(0.97, 0.92, 0.84)) -> Label:
  45 	var label := Label.new()
  46 	label.text = text_value
  47 	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
  48 	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
  49 	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
  50 	label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
  51 	parent.add_child(label)
  52 	return label
  53 
  54 func add_button(parent: Node, caption: String, action: String, node_name: String) -> Button:
  55 	var button := Button.new()
  56 	button.name = node_name
  57 	button.text = caption
  58 	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(340, 54)
  59 	button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
  60 	button.pressed.connect(func(): action_requested.emit(action))
  61 	parent.add_child(button)
  62 	buttons.append(button)
  63 	return button
  64 
  65 func set_active(active: bool) -> void:
  66 	visible = active
  67 	for button in buttons:
  68 		button.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_ALL if active and not button.disabled else Control.FOCUS_NONE
  69 	if active:
  70 		focus_first.call_deferred()
  71 
  72 func focus_first() -> void:
  73 	if not is_visible_in_tree():
  74 		return
  75 	for button in buttons:
  76 		if not button.disabled:
  77 			button.grab_focus()
  78 			return
  79 
  80 func refresh(snapshot: Dictionary) -> void:
  81 	if continue_button == null:
  82 		return
  83 	continue_button.disabled = not snapshot.get("can_continue", false)
  84 	continue_button.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_ALL if visible and not continue_button.disabled else Control.FOCUS_NONE
  85 	detail.text = snapshot.get("continue_notice", "")
  86 	if snapshot.get("save_status", "") == "failed":
  87 		detail.text = snapshot.get("message", detail.text)
